summary.text: Paul Scott is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives from District 111, which he has represented since 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; Jerry Blake, a Democrat, is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Paul Scott was born in Florida and received a graduate degree in business administration from Heriot-Watt University.
His career experience includes working as a pastor, firefighter, chaplain, and client technologies architect for the Duke University Health System.
He previously served on the Rutherford County Schools board, East Rutherford District, and succeeded Timothy K. Moore in the state House.
